override.repo_standard: Frozen G3 requires both shipped role prose and parsed spine contracts at Explorer, Commander, and Admiral boundaries.
override.reason: The limited prose/directive mirroring exposes human instructions and executable checklist interfaces; tests assert their agreement, so this is contract synchronization rather than accidental duplication.

override.repo_standard: CREW_CONTEXT requires strict public contracts, fail-fast boundary validation, and behavior assertions; G1/G2 freeze exact JSON artifacts.
override.reason: Boundary ids, decision enums, and artifact fields deliberately remain JSON primitives because the public portable contract is JSON and the installed verifier validates exact shape and enum semantics.

override.repo_standard: Frozen G3 explicitly wires the iterative chain through the three role owners and installer bundle table.
override.reason: The finite edits are required at distinct role-owned interfaces; one shared verifier centralizes behavior while each role retains only its own command and doctrine.
